extracted.intended_audience: students and general readers of political economy; economists and historians of economic thought
extracted.subtask_short: economic theory of wages and profit
extracted.subtask_description: Expository discussion (from a classical political economy text) of how prices of provisions, demand for labour, stock, interest, and competition determine wages, profits, and interest across countries and over time. It explains mechanisms (supply/demand, competition, accumulation of stock, legal/institutional effects) rather than providing prescriptive evaluation criteria.
